_meta.title: Lal Kitab Remedies (Upay / Totke)
_meta.description: Traditional Lal Kitab remedies organised by planet. Each planet has a set of GENERAL remedies (used when the planet is malefic anywhere) and a few HOUSE-SPECIFIC remedies. Remedies are deliberately simple, low-cost and symbolic — the hallmark of Lal Kitab.

remedy_fields.type: donation | ritual | conduct | object | mantra | feeding

global_rules: Do remedies for ONLY one or two afflicted planets at a time; avoid mixing many remedies together.
Most Lal Kitab remedies are done for 43 days continuously, or on the planet's weekday.
Never throw remedy articles in dirty places; flowing water (river) or clean earth is preferred.
Conduct-based remedies (respecting parents/elders, honesty) are considered the most powerful.
A remedy must never harm another person or animal; if it does, it is being done wrong.
_meta.disclaimer: These are cultural/traditional practices, NOT medical, legal, financial or psychological advice. Anyone with a real-world problem (health, money, legal, relationship) should consult a qualified professional. Always show this disclaimer with remedies. Do not advise fasting, gemstones or dietary changes to anyone for whom these may be unsafe.

general.instruction: Avoid alcohol and keep conduct dignified.
